last_funding.notes: Funding-history results list a June 2019 $15M Series B as the latest funding round. Aviso's dated 2017 press release separately confirms an $8M funding event, not the latest round.

launched_6mo.notes: On April 24, 2026, Aviso announced Spring 2026 product updates including Agent Studio, new agents, and several product capabilities, within the six months before the run date.

employee_band.notes: Built In lists 155 total employees, which falls in the 101-200 band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers site lists an Account Executive position with an application prompt. No SDR/BDR role is needed because Account Executive qualifies.

model_provider.value: Open-source models including Llama 3, Qwen, and DeepSeek R1, hosted on Aviso's internal servers, alongside proprietary NLP and deep-learning technology.

named_customers.notes: Each name appears as a customer in a case study.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers listing reviewed has engineering, sales, marketing, customer-success, and data-engineer roles, but no role title in the specified AI/ML/data-science categories. Data Engineer does not count under the task definition.

compliance_certs.notes: The product page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II and names ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. PCI DSS appears in a blog post but not on the cited compliance/product page, so it is not included.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Aviso's integrations page identifies each of these CRM/business systems as integrations.

product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an AI revenue platform and lists forecasting, pipeline inspection, deal acceleration, conversation intelligence, and related GTM products.
product_one_liner.value: Aviso is an AI-powered revenue operating platform that helps sales and go-to-market teams forecast revenue, inspect pipelines, improve deals, and act on customer and conversation intelligence.
